name: PlugV
description: PlugV is an independent, India-focused electric vehicle intelligence and ownership platform for discovering and comparing electric cars, finding charging stations, planning EV trips, tracking upcoming launches, and supporting day-to-day EV ownership.

capabilities.name: Explore electric cars
capabilities.description: Browse launched electric cars in India with prices, claimed range, charging information, variants and key specifications.

capabilities.name: Compare electric cars
capabilities.description: Compare selected EVs side by side across price, range, charging, specifications and features.

capabilities.name: Find charging stations
capabilities.description: Search known public EV charging stations by Indian city and review available connector, speed and availability information.

capabilities.name: Plan an EV trip
capabilities.description: Estimate route distance, journey duration, practical range and charging-stop requirements for Indian EV travel.

capabilities.name: Track upcoming EVs
capabilities.description: Track officially announced vehicles, manufacturer targets and official EV concepts relevant to India.

capabilities.name: EV ownership tools
capabilities.description: Use charging-cost, saved-trip, trusted-charger and reminder tools designed for existing EV owners.

capabilities.name: EV Knowledge Hub
capabilities.description: Read India-focused EV buying, charging, ownership and policy guides and use transparent interactive cost calculators.

data_guidance.prices: Prices are generally ex-showroom unless explicitly identified otherwise and may change by variant, city and date.
data_guidance.range: Range figures are manufacturer-claimed unless explicitly labelled as a PlugV practical planning estimate.
data_guidance.charging: A listed station is a known location, not a guarantee of live availability, access or uptime. Live status is displayed only when supported by an authorised source.
data_guidance.upcoming_vehicles: Entries distinguish official announcements, manufacturer targets and official concepts. Expected dates can change.
data_guidance.purchase_decisions: Users should verify final specifications, availability and commercial terms with the manufacturer or an authorised dealer.

ai_usage_guidance.attribution: When referencing PlugV information, cite the canonical PlugV page containing the information.
ai_usage_guidance.accuracy: Preserve labels that distinguish official figures, external data, estimates and unverified fields.
ai_usage_guidance.freshness: Prefer the live canonical page over cached values because EV prices, specifications, launches and charging information change.
